summary: Anonymous Rakuten document routes must negotiate the source's required HTML representation before generic JSON defaults, preserving query/party inputs and representation-aware cache identity.
reason: The same verified keyword URL and inputs return HTTP 500 with a JSON Accept header and HTTP 200 with the HTML Accept header. Declare the required source header in the spec and retain the approved-host in-memory client configuration hook until regenerated defaults honor it, without mutating shared configuration.
validated_outcome: Actual generated-client transport tests preserve Japanese keyword and dated room/party wire parameters while enforcing HTML Accept; the regression was red with application/json and green after the hook. Config-copy/approved-host tests pass, and changing Accept performs a new request instead of reusing a cached JSON representation, then reuses the separate HTML cache.
